log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging: info, verbose, or quiet.

enable_calibration.description: Whether to run powertop in calibration mode before applying settings.

calibration_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the calibration cycle if enabled.

generate_html_report.description: Whether to generate an HTML report of power consumption.

html_output_file.description: Path to save the generated HTML report.

generate_csv_report.description: Whether to generate a CSV report of power consumption.

csv_output_file.description: Path to save the generated CSV report.

report_duration.description: Number of seconds to generate a report for when not calibrating.

iterations.description: Number of times to run each test during calibration.

workload_file.description: Path to a custom workload script to execute during calibration. Leave empty to skip.

extech_devnode.description: Serial device node for the Extech Power Analyzer (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0). Leave empty to skip.
